lifecycle.boundary: No independent offsite/site failure domain is proven.
lifecycle.name: raw-preservation

majorChangesSinceR1: Entity/reference resolution moved from MISSING to PILOT_PROVEN_CROSS_DOMAIN_PARTIAL using ROR/ISO mapping semantics.
DCAT, ODCS and OpenLineage moved from design-only to real GitHub pilot evidence.
Raw/derived/runtime evidence moved from reacquirable-only to accepted local AIP preservation with master+replica+fixity.
Temporal revision/schema/late-arrival semantics were externalized to Git identity, ISO mapping, Iceberg conformance rules and Beam/Debezium activation gates.
Heavy infrastructure remains workload-gated.
Research owns an ODPS 1.1.0 + ODCS 3.2.0 product for the Paper1 frozen benchmark; source hash and 61 observed downstream digest references prove a real consumer chain.
Finance owns an ODPS 1.1.0 + ODCS 3.2.0 consumer-aligned product for the read-only Binance+OKX public shadow; no credentials/private data/external financial writes are admitted.
A two-domain DCAT 3 federation now exposes both domain-owned products without moving ownership into ordivon-next.
PROV-O now records source-to-product derivation for both domains and dataset-to-result derivation for Paper1; Finance post-registration decision consumption is intentionally still unproven.
Research and Finance domain products now have ODPS Team ownership scoped to product metadata/lifecycle rather than source intellectual-property rights.
Each product now owns a W3C ODRL 2.2 Set policy prohibiting third-party distribution, grantUse and automatic deletion while source rights and retention requirements remain unresolved.
NIST Privacy Framework 1.0 is the published privacy-risk baseline; 1.1 remains an Initial Public Draft as of 2026-09-20.
ISO 15489-1:2016 is used to require actual records/retention requirements instead of inventing a duration.
The DCAT federation links each Dataset/ODRL Asset to its domain-owned ODRL policy through odrl:hasPolicy.

Research now emits a schema-valid OpenLineage START/COMPLETE run binding product version plus the pre-existing robustness result to a new verification artifact; it explicitly does not claim to generate the scientific result.
Finance now emits a schema-valid post-registration OpenLineage run from the exact public-shadow product version to a new decision/outcome/feedback artifact with no external financial effect.
PROV-O now represents both post-registration runtime consumptions as semantic derivation activities.

Finance feedback explicitly keeps the public-observation collection boundary, frozen 1200 ms quality gates, no directional model update, and fail-closed governance because all measured windows passed and no evidence justified expanding claims.
The selected P0 queue is empty; a non-trivial feedback event that actually changes policy remains P1.
Experimental Episode Corpus R1 is admitted as a third real internal data product without transferring Runtime/Harness/domain truth.
The stable product identity is the replay-qualified corpus manifest; PostgreSQL remains a rebuildable analytical materialization.
A deterministic 10,007-row flat Parquet Episode index is byte-replayable and passes the existing Artifact Dataset R1 DuckDB+PyArrow verifier.
SystemAnalysisR1 product consumption is bound by OpenLineage 2.0.2 and PROV-O; generalization and intervention remain explicitly NOT_IDENTIFIED.
Episode data-health gauges completed a real OpenTelemetry SDK -> Vector -> Prometheus read-back while preserving Workstation cold-by-default desired state.

p1Queue.goal: Add a genuinely independent failure-domain/offsite copy when an approved storage target exists; current replica is same-host.
Make preservation provider liveness observable so scheduled fixity cannot silently fail when Archivematica is stopped.
Map proven Artifact Dataset Contract facts to ODCS without replacing Artifact's bounded verifier.
Expose freshness/volume/schema/quality/lineage-break metrics through existing Prometheus/OTel before adding a new observability platform.
Keep DCAT as file-based federated metadata while two-domain discovery is sufficient; activate a catalog service only when query/collaboration/scale proves the need.
Resolve source/provider licenses or terms per product before allowing redistribution, grantUse or public external distributions; do not infer rights from public accessibility.
Complete product-appropriate privacy-risk assessment using NIST Privacy Framework 1.0 current baseline; migrate only when PF 1.1 becomes final.
Derive retention/disposition schedules from actual research/business/legal records requirements under ISO 15489; replace the temporary no-delete policy only when an authority is assigned.
Prove one real post-outcome feedback event whose evidence requires a change to collection, quality or model policy; the current finance witness legitimately returns NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED.
Measure a downstream research/product/business/distribution outcome beyond boundary preservation and technical acceptance.
Extend the same externally owned lifecycle contracts to additional real domains only when a real consumer exists.

thesis: Research and Finance retain their proven domain-owned lifecycle loops. R6 adds Experimental Episode Corpus R1 as a third real internal analytical product using the same external owners: ODPS/ODCS, DCAT, Artifact Parquet verification, OpenLineage, PROV-O, fail-closed ODRL governance and bounded OTLP/Prometheus observability. Broader lifecycle remains PARTIAL because generalization/intervention study design, source rights/retention/privacy closure, independent preservation and broader business-value outcomes remain open.
